svg.title: Single-strap Maxwell field and actual tetrahedral mesh
svg.desc: Direct NGSolve field samples and a geometric slice of the Netgen tetrahedral mesh. Fields normalized to one watt of delivered gap-source power, not one watt of core absorption.
